2018 Philippine Input–Output Network — 240 Industries + Final Demand

Circles are production industries; boxes are final-demand destinations. Node size = actual value added. Production edges use aᵢⱼ ≥ 0.03. Demand arrows show contributors ≥1% of each category; inventory arrows use ≥1% of absolute inventory movements.
